status.description: Status code of the closing order.

type.description: Event type code of the closing order response.

symbol.description: Market symbol of the closing order (e.g. BTC-PERP).

postOnly.description: Whether the closing order is post-only.

orderSide.description: Side of the closing order (opposite to the position direction).

orderId.description: Server-assigned order id of the closing order.

clOrderID.description: Client-assigned order id echoed back, if provided in the request.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the response, in milliseconds since epoch.

price.description: Requested limit price of the closing order (0 for market orders).

avgFilledPrice.description: Average fill price achieved so far.

originalOrderSize.description: Original order size at submission, in contracts.

currentOrderSize.description: Current remaining size on the order book, in contracts.

filledSize.description: Size filled by the most recent fill event, in contracts.

totalFilledSize.description: Total size filled since order submission, in contracts.

remainingSize.description: Size still outstanding on the order, in contracts.

positionMode.description: Position mode of the closed position (ONE_WAY or HEDGE).

positionDirection.description: Position direction of the closed position (LONG or SHORT).

positionId.description: Identifier of the position being closed.

timeInForce.description: Time-in-force applied to the closing order (e.g. GTC, IOC, FOK).
